name: Flagellant
summary: Flagellant; Once per round, when you take damage, your next melee attack deals +1d6 bonus damage.  Flagellant; When you take damage, gain temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.  Flagellant; Once per turn, when you are below half hit points, your melee attacks deal +1d8 radiant or fire damage.  Flagellant; The first time each round you take damage, gain temporary HP equal to twice your proficiency bonus.
descriptionMarkdown:
Flagellant; Once per round, when you take damage, your next melee attack deals +1d6 bonus damage.

Flagellant; When you take damage, gain temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.

Flagellant; Once per turn, when you are below half hit points, your melee attacks deal +1d8 radiant or fire damage.

Flagellant; The first time each round you take damage, gain temporary HP equal to twice your proficiency bonus.
